prior_summary: Attachment-confirmation prior implemented as a learned action diffusion policy: the denoiser is conditioned on causal TCP/object/finger relative-motion features, a learned active-block selector, and learned attachment probabilities; auxiliary losses supervise attachment from future demonstration evidence and train an action-conditioned future relative-offset predictor.
applicable_conditions: Use when the gripper is approaching or over the active block, the fingers are open or closing, object poses and finger qpos/qvel are available in the state vector, and the task follows the demonstrated contact mechanics for grasping 4 cm blocks with the Panda parallel gripper.
termination_guidance: Continue this policy through approach, closure, and lift until the active object is close to the TCP, fingers are near the demonstrated closed width, recent TCP/object motion suggests stable coupling, and the object has reached an early carry state. Then delivery can take over while monitoring the same attachment cues.
limitations: Training demonstrations contain successful grasps and no deliberately failed grasps, so negative attachment supervision comes mostly from pre-contact and open-finger portions. The model has no analytic IK, no force sensing, no image input, and no hard grasp constraint; attachment is a learned state prediction from the available observations.

config.attachment_label_description: Soft labels are computed from future training observations only during training: closed fingers, active object near TCP, stable future TCP-object relative offset, and present or imminent lift above table height. Deployment uses only the model's causal prediction from the last two observations.
